name: Trout Coconut Curry with Mustard and Curry Leaf
description: Fresh rainbow trout fillets poached in a fragrant coconut milk reduction with bloomed black mustard seeds, fresh curry leaves, green chilli, and a touch of Dijon mustard. A Pakistani-French fusion fish curry that comes together in 35 minutes.
keywords: trout coconut curry, coconut mustard fish, french trout curry, mustard curry leaf fish, halal fish curry
recipeIngredient: 4 rainbow trout fillets, skin on, pin-boned, approximately 180 g (6 oz) each
1 medium white onion, finely diced (about 150 g / 5 oz)
400 ml (14 fl oz) full-fat coconut milk
100 ml (3½ fl oz) fish stock or light chicken stock
Small handful of fresh coriander leaves
Thinly sliced green chilli, to finish

recipeInstructions.name: Season the fish
recipeInstructions.text: Pat the trout fillets dry with kitchen paper. Mix the salt, turmeric, and Kashmiri chilli powder, then dust the flesh side of each fillet evenly. Set aside at room temperature for 10 minutes.

recipeInstructions.name: Bloom the seeds
recipeInstructions.text: Heat the oil in a wide, deep skillet over medium-high heat. When the oil shimmers, add the black mustard seeds and cumin seeds. Once they pop and the cumin is fragrant, add the curry leaves immediately.

recipeInstructions.name: Build the base
recipeInstructions.text: Add the onion and reduce heat to medium. Cook, stirring occasionally, until the onion is deep golden and softened at the edges, about 8–10 minutes.

recipeInstructions.name: Add aromatics and spices
recipeInstructions.text: Add the garlic, ginger, and green chillies. Stir continuously for 90 seconds. Add the ground coriander, ground cumin, and black pepper. Stir for another 30 seconds to toast the spices in the residual fat.

recipeInstructions.name: Build the sauce
recipeInstructions.text: Pour in the coconut milk and stock. Stir in the Dijon mustard. Bring to a gentle simmer. Taste and adjust salt. Simmer uncovered for 4 minutes to let the sauce reduce slightly.

recipeInstructions.name: Poach the trout
recipeInstructions.text: Reduce heat to low. Lay the trout fillets skin-side down into the sauce. Spoon a little liquid over each fillet. Cover the pan and cook for 6–8 minutes until the flesh is opaque throughout and flakes with gentle pressure.

recipeInstructions.name: Finish and serve
recipeInstructions.text: Remove from heat. Add the lime juice to the sauce around the fish. Scatter fresh coriander leaves and sliced green chilli over the top. Serve immediately with steamed basmati rice.
